components.notice: Single-component literature/measurement reference. A published sample point is not a universal population mean; no unreported SD is invented.

limitations: Additive component references are not a validated methane yield of the mixture. No synergy coefficient is assumed.
Known-part subtotal is neither the full mixture prediction nor a lower bound on actual co-digestion yield.
Separate volumes may not add to final packed/liquid mixture volume; verify actual charge.
C/N requires carbon and nitrogen masses. pH cannot be averaged. Batch loading is not a daily OLR.
Sensitivity bounds have no verified probability coverage.

studies.conditions: Specific cattle slurry at HRT 16/20 d; acclimated cultures and controlled operation
Specific bedded cattle/ground cafeteria food/pig slurry; diluted 30 d laboratory assay

tradeoffs: Higher temperature may improve conversion in some studies but increases heat demand and can change ammonia/process stability.
Quantity affects heat capacity and vessel/loading feasibility, not a biological optimum by itself.

studies.conditions: Untreated RM1, 37°C, AMPTS II; endpoint test, not prescribed operation

distinctions.HRT: Working liquid volume / total daily liquid flow
distinctions.SRT: Retention of solids; not automatically equal to HRT
distinctions.BATCH_EXPERIMENT: Elapsed time of a specified batch experiment

missing: Matched validated kinetics, inoculum and loading information before predicting batch completion or start-up
duration.notice: 27-day BMP incubation is not a required plant residence time. No time minimization without a suitable kinetic model.

relevant_studies.finding: Interaction changed with composition and incubation time, with both antagonism and synergy. No coefficient is transferred to another batch.
Studied shredded garden grass, cow manure and specific sludge in 7 L batch, not arbitrary fresh grass plus food waste.

stability.notice: No numerical stability score or additive pH/CN average is invented.

methane_fraction.evidence: FNR cattle-slurry references 55% (2024) and 60% (2006); cross-reference sensitivity, not same sample

assumptions: CH4 and total biogas at identical temperature, pressure and moisture basis assumed
biogas.scope: Potential gas corresponding to laboratory methane potential, not collected plant gas. CH4 is part of biogas and must not be added again.
biogas.uncertainty: Independent extrema envelope; unknown correlation and no validated probability coverage.
biogas.recovery_notice: Conditional collected volume under selected recovery; distinct from laboratory potential and not a measured reactor output.
